description: This is a shell script used for testing purposes, specifically testing tail optimization in diff outputs. It defines functions to generate large strings and perform text replacements, sets up test cases with different input sizes, and verifies diff outputs against expected patterns.

methods.name: zs
methods.description: Generates a string consisting of repeated patterns of 'z' with length specified by the argument.

methods.name: zc
methods.description: Processes input through sed to perform a series of substitutions for diff pattern testing.

methods.name: expect_pattern
methods.description: Generates expected diff output patterns for test verification based on input size.
